messages.content: I’ll commit the DA position for the highest-value hours, then adjust the physical schedule as RT prices and notices arrive, preserving capacity for the evening reserve-risk window.
The battery is full at 225 MWh, with 16 discharge units remaining. RT prices have stayed well below DA prices so far; I’m holding the physical discharge for 20:00–21:00, the highest-priced DA hour.
